message.content:
Here are some of the major airports in the United States, sorted roughly by passenger traffic (largest to smaller but still significant hubs):

| Airport | City / State | IATA Code | Notes |
|---------|--------------|-----------|-------|
| Hartsfield‑Jackson Atlanta International Airport | Atlanta, GA | ATL | Largest airport in the world by passenger traffic. Major hub for Delta Air Lines. |
| Los Angeles International Airport | Los Angeles, CA | LAX | One of the busiest airports on the West Coast; major hub for American Airlines and United. |
| Chicago O’Hare International Airport | Chicago, IL | ORD | Major hub for United and American; one of the busiest airports in North America. |
| Dallas/Fort Worth International Airport | Dallas–Fort Worth, TX | DFW | Major hub for American Airlines; largest airport in Texas. |
| Denver International Airport | Denver, CO | DEN | Major hub for United and Southwest; largest airport in Colorado. |
| John F. Kennedy International Airport | New York City, NY | JFK | Major hub for American and Delta; one of the busiest airports in the U.S. |
| San Francisco International Airport | San Francisco, CA | SFO | Major hub for United and a key gateway to Asia. |
| Seattle–Tacoma International Airport | Seattle, WA | SEA | Major hub for Alaska Airlines and a growing hub for United. |
| Miami International Airport | Miami, FL | MIA | Major hub for American and a key gateway to Latin America. |
| Charlotte Douglas International Airport | Charlotte, NC | CLT | Major hub for American Airlines; one of the fastest‑growing airports. |
| Phoenix Sky Harbor International Airport | Phoenix, AZ | PHX | Major hub for American and a growing hub for Southwest. |
| Orlando International Airport | Orlando, FL | ORL | Major hub for Southwest; key airport for tourism. |
| Newark Liberty International Airport | Newark, NJ | EWR | Major hub for United; serves the New York metropolitan area. |
| Washington Dulles International Airport | Washington, DC | IAD | Major hub for United; serves the nation's capital. |
| Detroit Metropolitan Wayne County Airport | Detroit, MI | DTW | Major hub for Delta; one of the largest airports in the Midwest. |
| Minneapolis–Saint Paul International Airport | Minneapolis–Saint Paul, MN | MSP | Major hub for United; key airport in the Upper Midwest. |
| Boston Logan International Airport | Boston, MA | BOS | Major hub for JetBlue and a key airport for the Northeast. |
| Philadelphia International Airport | Philadelphia, PA | PHL | Major hub for American; serves the Mid-Atlantic region. |
| Salt Lake City International Airport | Salt Lake City, UT | SLC | Major hub for Delta; key airport for the Mountain West. |
| Baltimore/Washington International Thurgood Marshall Airport | Baltimore, MD | BWI | Major hub for Southwest; serves the Mid-Atlantic region. |

These airports are among the busiest in terms of passenger enplanements and serve as major hubs for the largest U.S. carriers. They also have extensive international connections and are critical nodes in the national and global air transport network.
